name: logseq-geml-sync
description: GEML Sync for Logseq 2.0 DB graphs: signals the external geml-sync watcher when the graph changes, and shows the last sync result. The plugin never touches your files — it is a change signal and a status light; the sync and git live in the watcher.

logseq.title: GEML Sync
logseq.description: Git-friendly plain-text (.geml) mirror of your DB graph — this plugin signals the external geml-sync watcher and shows its status.
